question: 'Nagaur Fair' is held in which of the following state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nagaur Fair**, also known as the **Cattle Fair of Nagaur**, is one of the largest cattle fairs in **Rajasthan**.
 
• It is celebrated annually in the town of **Nagaur**, which is located in the northwestern region of Rajasthan.
 
• The fair primarily revolves around the trading of animals such as **cows, camels, horses, and bullocks**. Farmers and traders come from across the country to participate.
 
• In addition to the cattle trading, the fair features **traditional Rajasthani cultural activities**, including folk music, dances, and sports competitions like tug-of-war and camel races.
